_comment: Example KNR estimate-code mapping for Wenta.KnrMap (issue #54). EVERY CODE BELOW IS A PLACEHOLDER, NOT A REAL KNR POSITION: configure per your KNR edition (KNR 2-08 or equivalent) before using for estimates. Keys starting with '_' are ignored by the parser.
_schema_version: Integer. This build accepts 1; a newer value is rejected with an error naming both versions.
_edition: Free-text label of the KNR edition these codes come from; shown in error messages and available as KnrMap.Edition.

codes._comment: Item kind -> code. Kinds emitted by Bom: duct, flex, fitting, terminal, source. An empty string means 'deliberately no position' (not reported as unmapped); a kind that is absent leaves the BOM row's code empty AND lists the kind in Bom.Unmapped / KnrMap.Unmapped.

overrides._comment: Overrides are checked before 'codes', in this order; the first match wins. 'match.kind' is required; 'shape' (round | rectangular) and 'type' (tee | inline | component class name) are optional and must equal the BOM item's value exactly when present.
